Respondents (By Sri Manjunath K., HCGP)

This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India, praying to call for the records and issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ or order/
directions to the respondents to determine and pay the compensation amount in respect of the aforesaid lands acquired from the father of the first petitioner under section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation Act, 2013 along with interest as applicable from the date of preliminary notification issued under section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 on 25.04.1978 in No.LAQ.HRP.CR.23/78-79 vide Annexure-B in respect of the lands described in the schedule hereunder acquired as the respondents failed to act in accordance with the law in the matter of payment of compensation and has failed to tender/deposit of the amount in the account of the petitioner.

This Writ Petition, coming on for preliminary hearing in 'B'
Group, this day, order was made therein as under:

sentences.text: In this writ petition, the grievance of the petitioners is with regard to the fact that the land belonging to the petitioners has been acquired.
However no compensation has been paid to the petitioners, and as such the petitioners have approached respondent no.3 by legal notice dated 03.02.2023 (Annexure 'F').
In that view of the matter, respondent no.3 is directed to consider the legal notice dated 03.02.2023 with an outer limit of three months.
With this observation, writ petition is disposed of.

SD/-
